stocks.name: ヨドコウ
stocks.businessSummary: Yodoko, Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sales of steel products for industrial and consumer products in Japan. The company offers repainted steel, galvanized steel, chromate-free treated steel, and cold rolled products; building material, such as roofing products, siding products, rooftop greenery systems, solar power generation systems, and installation of roofing and siding; exterior products, including storage sheds, houses, carports, garages, warehouses, trash bins, and bicycle parks; Rolls comprising large machinery components that support manufacturing, including paper, packaging film, and rubber and steel; yodo water falls (overflow-suppression grating), yodo karugaru grating, yodo ex grating, yodo galfan grating, and other gratings; household equipment, household implements, and building materials. It also provides design and contracting construction work, warehousing, packaging and shipping, sale, purchase and leasing of real estate, building of produce cultivation facilities and landscaping, and associated business activities. Yodoko, Ltd. was formerly known as Yodogawa Steel Works, Ltd. and changed its name to Yodoko, Ltd. in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

stocks.name: 日本高純度化学
stocks.businessSummary: Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells precious metal plating chemicals for electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company provides gold electrolytic plating formulation for semiconductor applications, as well as PWB, connector, contact, and soldering applications; flash gold plating formulation for lead frame uses; and palladium electrolytic formulation for connector and lead frame uses. It also offers gold plating formulation for soldering and wire bonding; electroless palladium plating formulation for wire bonding and soldering uses; and electrolytic and electroless silver plating formulations. In addition, the company provides anti-bacterial agents for plating tanks and drag-out tanks; and impurity removal resin that removes Cu ions dissolved in Au and palladium plating formulation. Additionally, it offers surface treatment chemicals and stripping agents. Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

stocks.name: エスクロー・エージェント・ジャパン
stocks.businessSummary: MITRA Group, Inc. engages in transaction support in the fields of transaction procedures and settlements related to finance, real estate, and construction in Japan. It operates in four segments: Financial Solutions, Real Estate Solutions, Architectural Solutions, and Professional Solutions. The company provides comprehensive support for mortgage-related services; inheritance-related services; as well as an escrow platform system, a comprehensive management solution that connects financial institutions and legal professionals through a cloud system. It also offers cashless and non-face-to-face payment services for real estate transactions, real estate collateral investigation and valuation services, and real estate auction services. In addition, the company provides a wide range of services for residential construction, such as 3D surveying, creation of application drawings, and completed building inspections and after-sales inspections. Further, it offers comprehensive support systems for legal scrivener work, and heir identification systems using AI and patented technology. The company was formerly known as Escrow Agent Japan, Inc. and changed its name to MITRA Group, Inc. in June 2026. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
